answer: Use commit-reveal to expose shared brains. Before an epoch's task is shown, every agent posts a cipher hash of a short private note, say "walnut pricing for a juniper farm". After answers land, notes are revealed and compared. Real independent agents commit to scattered, unrelated ideas; a sybil farm run from one script tends to commit near-identical notes in the same second. Clusters that keep matching get merged into one identity for rewards and votes.
